remarks: Move right into this bright and spacious townhome in Stamford's sought-after Marina Bay Complex. Designed with an open floor plan and filled with natural light, this home provides comfortable living and stunning views of Long Island Sound. The main level features a generously sized kitchen, a large living room with a handsome fireplace, and sliders opening to a private balcony, where you can enjoy miles of scenic water views. The formal dining room, also with water views, is perfect for hosting warm gatherings. Upstairs, the primary suite boasts its own private balcony overlooking the Sound, a spacious layout, and a recently updated full bath. Two additional bedrooms and a full hall bath complete the upper level, offering ample space for family or guests. The walk-out Lower Level is an entertainer's dream, with a large family Room, a full bath, and sliders leading to a private deck and garden area-perfect for enjoying the waterfront lifestyle. Marina Bay residents benefit from beautifully maintained landscaping, a waterfront pool, and a recently renovated clubhouse. Ideally located in the Shippan area, this home is just minutes from Stamford's downtown, train station, and nearby beaches. Enjoy the best of coastal living right at your doorstep!
